entities.summary: Pedro de Mena y Medrano was a prominent Spanish sculptor during the baroque period. After Alonso Cano's death in 1667, Pedro de Mena y Medrano became the top sculptor in the Iberian Peninsula. He became the official sculptor of the Toledo Cathedral and a Familiar of the Holy Office of Granada.
